description: A catalogue of publicly disclosed path-traversal (CWE-22) weaknesses in machine-learning model loaders that resolve an untrusted shard/external-data filename against the model directory without a containment check. All entries share one root cause: a value taken from an attacker-controlled model package (a safetensors/pytorch *.index.json weight_map, an ONNX external-data `location`, or a chat-template path) is joined onto the model directory with os.path.join / pathlib and opened, so an absolute path or a '..' segment escapes the package and reads (or writes) an arbitrary local file at load time. Compiled and verified from public sources by MV2 of Munim, Inc. This work was made with AI.
detector: safetensors_index_scan.py in munimtechnologies/keras-model-scan statically flags the *.index.json weight_map form of this class (rules STI001 absolute, STI002 '..', STI003 backslash, STI004 URL/fsspec scheme, STI005 subdirectory, STI006 NUL byte). It reads only the JSON text; it never opens a shard or loads a model.
verification_note: Each 'verified' field records what was confirmed from the cited public source on the stated date (project, identifier, vulnerable function, fix status). Entries in 'community_reports' are real issues in real projects whose maintainer acceptance was NOT independently confirmed here; they are included as leads, not as settled vulnerabilities.

verified_advisories.root_cause: Shard filenames from a model index JSON weight_map are joined onto the model directory and opened without a containment check; '../' sequences or absolute paths escape the directory and read arbitrary files during model loading.
verified_advisories.verified: Confirmed 2026-10-14: real assigned CVE, project huggingface/diffusers, function _get_checkpoint_shard_files, CWE-22, fixed in commit cee298c, published 2026-07-23.

verified_advisories.root_cause: Reads model.safetensors.index.json and uses weight_map scale-tensor values as file paths without validation; an absolute or '..'-containing scale entry (e.g. in an MXFP4 block-quantized checkpoint) reads files outside the checkpoint directory.
verified_advisories.fix_ref: PR #199436 (resolve + is_relative_to containment check), pending at compile time
verified_advisories.verified: Confirmed 2026-10-14: issue #199028 carries GHSA-f569-37c9-8pv7, security + triaged labels, linked fix PR #199436, open; opened 2026-09-29.

verified_advisories.root_cause: An ONNX tensor's external-data 'location' is joined onto the model directory without sanitisation; a malicious .onnx file reads an arbitrary local file at load time, with contents surfacing in inference output. Same root cause as the weight_map class in a sibling model format.
verified_advisories.verified: Confirmed 2026-10-14: CVE-2026-55832 / GHSA-h668-6x6g-f8r5, crate tract-onnx, CWE-22 external-data location traversal, patched in 0.21.17/0.22.3/0.23.2.

verified_advisories.root_cause: A chat-template file path taken from untrusted model data is resolved against the model directory without a containment check (sibling sink to the weight_map class: same join-untrusted-path-onto-model-dir pattern, different field).
verified_advisories.verified: Referenced as a real CVE in the same class; identifier CVE-2026-9856 (transformers save_pretrained chat-template traversal). Included as a related sink, not a weight_map case.

verified_advisories.root_cause: weight_map shard filenames were passed into request URLs (and local path joins) without validation; a crafted repo could, with the caller's token, redirect a same-host metadata fetch to another repo, or on the local branch read a header outside the folder.
verified_advisories.fix_ref: Proposed _validate_weight_map via _validate_relative_filename; CLOSED won't-fix by maintainer as out-of-threat-model (same-host only, response returns to the victim not the attacker, header bytes only)
verified_advisories.verified: Confirmed 2026-10-14: PRs #4916 and #4935 proposed weight_map validation and were both CLOSED 2026-09-18 by the maintainer as 'not a security issue, very corner case'. Included to mark the boundary of the threat model, not as a confirmed vulnerability.

community_reports.root_cause: Joins each weight_map value onto the model directory with os.path.join and no containment check; a crafted package (JSON + safetensors only, no code) reads tensors from outside the package.
community_reports.verified: Confirmed 2026-10-14: real, actively maintained project (~1.6k stars). Issue content matches the class; maintainer acceptance not independently confirmed here.

community_reports.root_cause: Resolves shard filenames from weight_map with a bare os.path.join(ckpt_dir, filename); an absolute or '../' value reads a file outside the checkpoint directory into the state dict.
community_reports.verified: Confirmed 2026-10-14: issue exists in a real maintained project (Tenstorrent). Maintainer acceptance not independently confirmed here.

community_reports.root_cause: The converter opens safetensors files named by weight_map values; a '../' or absolute value makes it open out-of-pack scale shards and silently alter converted weights.
community_reports.verified: Confirmed 2026-10-14: issue exists in a real maintained project (Alibaba). Maintainer acceptance not independently confirmed here.
